description: Frozen rank-four later-head gauges. For each held-out token edit, compare selected axis against eight task-discovery-selected random-rotation axes with the largest local post-c_proj edit dose. Both interventions are scaled to the smaller dose for that pair. Finite full-model correct-minus-foil margin changes are oriented by the full rank-four path sign. The unlabeled mode uses answer-free edit-response fitting and global response-energy axis selection; excluded conditions remove the entire matching edit type. This is a within-reduced-model causal-dose comparison, not a physical necessity test.
random_axis_selection: best mean absolute local task effect on discovery pairs for each random rotation
